paragraphs: Legado was built on a conviction: brands in the United States, and especially Latino-owned ones, deserve the same strategic depth that global agencies deliver to Fortune 500s, but from someone who truly understands them. Someone who knows both worlds, both languages, and both markets

Victoria Urbaneja founded Legado Creativo to fill that gap. Not as another design shop, but as a strategic partner who combines business vision with creative execution, and walks alongside clients from the first conversation to real impact

We believe a brand isn't built from design, it's built from clarity. When you know exactly who you are, who you're speaking to, and what you want people to feel when they discover you, design stops being decoration and becomes communication. That's what we do: help you find that clarity, then turn it into something that looks right, feels right, and is remembered

members.name: Victoria Urbaneja
members.bio: Victoria Urbaneja is a journalist, publicist, and founder of Legado Creativo. With a background in strategic communications for global brands including Adidas, Novartis, and Univision, Victoria brings editorial vision, strategic thinking, and creative execution to every brand she builds. Her purpose is clear: to give the Latino community in the United States a voice, and to make sure that voice is heard with the same strength and professionalism as any world-class brand

items.question: How does a project with Legado start?
items.answer: Everything starts with a conversation. You tell us about your business, goals, and audience. From there, we build a customized strategic proposal

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. A complete brand identity takes 4-8 weeks. A monthly content strategy can be ready in 1-2 weeks. We give you clear timelines before we start

items.question: Do you work in English and Spanish?
items.answer: Yes. Everything we do is available in both languages, from strategy to copy and design pieces

items.question: Do you only work with Latino brands?
items.answer: No. Legado works with any brand that wants to connect with the Latino market, the American market, or both. Our edge is understanding both worlds

items.question: What does the revision process include?
items.answer: Every project includes defined revision rounds from the start so the final result is exactly what you need

items.question: Do you offer support after delivering the project?
items.answer: Yes. We don't disappear when we deliver. We support implementation and are available for adjustments

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: {legalName} ("Legado Creativo," "we," "us," or "our") is a creative and brand strategy studio based in Boston, Massachusetts, in the United States. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect personal information when you visit {website} (the "Site"), contact us through our contact form, email, phone, or social media, receive our communications, or work with us as a client or collaborator (together, the "Service").

By using the Site, you acknowledge this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with it, please do not use the Site or send us personal information. Residents of certain U.S. states, and visitors from outside the United States, will find additional information in the sections "State privacy rights (United States)" and "Notice to visitors outside the United States."

blocks.p: This summary is for convenience. The full policy below controls.

list: **What we collect:** the details you send through our contact form (name, email, company, service of interest, and your message) and basic technical data about your visit.
**Why:** to answer your inquiry, deliver our services, keep the Site secure, and understand how the Site is used.

**Who we share it with:** only service providers that help us run the Site and our business (such as hosting, email delivery, and bot protection), professional advisors, and authorities when the law requires it.
**What we do not do:** we do not sell your personal information, we do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising, and we do not use advertising cookies or tracking pixels on the Site.
**Your control:** you can ask us to access, correct, or delete your information, or opt out of marketing emails, at any time by writing to {email}.

blocks.p: Personal information you may provide through the Site or otherwise includes:

list: **Contact data**, such as your name, email address, and company name, and, if you choose to share them, your phone number, job title, and mailing address.

**Communications data**, such as the service you are interested in, the content of your message (for example, project goals, timelines, and budget), and our correspondence with you by form, email, phone, or social media.

**Client engagement data**, if you become a client or collaborator: billing and mailing addresses, project briefs, brand assets and files you share with us, approvals and feedback, and invoicing and transaction records. Payment card and bank details are collected by our payment providers, not through the Site.
**Marketing data**, such as your preferences for receiving communications from us.

blocks.p: Our contact form asks only for your name, email address, company (optional), the service you are interested in, and your message. **Please do not include sensitive information** in the form or in your emails to us, such as Social Security or other government ID numbers, financial account or payment card numbers, health information, or passwords. We do not need it to respond to your inquiry.
When you visit the Site, we and our service providers automatically log certain information about your device and your interaction with the Site, such as:

list: **Device data**, such as your IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device type, screen size, language setting, and approximate location (city, region, or country) inferred from your IP address.
**Online activity data**, such as the pages you view, the website that referred you, and the date and time of your visit.
**Security data**, such as request logs and signals used to tell real visitors from bots (including by Cloudflare Turnstile) and to limit abusive traffic.

blocks.p: We may receive information about you from social media platforms (for example, if you message or interact with us on Instagram or Facebook), from public sources such as your company's website or professional profiles, from referrals, and from service providers that support our business. We may combine it with the information you give us.
The Site has no user accounts or passwords, does not process payments, and does not request your precise geolocation. We do not knowingly collect information from children (see "Children's privacy").

sections.heading: How we use your personal information

blocks.p: We use personal information for the following purposes, or as otherwise described when we collect it:

list: **Respond to you and deliver our services:** to read and answer your inquiries, send an automatic confirmation that we received your message, prepare proposals, contracts, and invoices, and carry out client projects.
**Operate and secure the Site:** to host and maintain the Site, protect it with spam filtering, bot detection, and rate limiting, fix errors, and prevent fraud, abuse, and cyberattacks.

**Improve the Site and our services:** to understand which pages are visited, how visitors reach the Site, and how it performs, so we can improve content, design, and speed. We use Vercel Web Analytics for this, which measures aggregated traffic without cookies.

**Communicate with you:** to send service-related messages and, where permitted by law (and with your consent where required), occasional updates about our work. You can opt out of marketing messages at any time.
**Comply with the law and protect rights:** to meet legal obligations, respond to lawful requests, enforce our Terms of Service, and establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.
**Create aggregated or de-identified data:** data that no longer identifies you, which we may use for lawful business purposes. We will not try to re-identify it.
**Further uses:** for other purposes disclosed at the time of collection or compatible with the original purpose. If a new purpose is not compatible, we will ask for your consent first.

blocks.p: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.
Cookies are small files placed on your device. Similar technologies include browser local storage and pixel tags. This section is our Cookie Notice for the Site.
The Site uses only a minimal set of these technologies. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies, social media tracking pixels, or session-replay tools.

blocks.p: **Emails.** We do not use tracking pixels in our emails to measure opens or clicks. Our email provider may record technical delivery events, such as whether a message was delivered or bounced.

list: **Browser controls.** Most browsers let you block or delete cookies and local storage in their settings. If you do, parts of the Site, such as the language memory and the contact form's security check, may not work as intended.

**Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track.** The Site does not track you across other websites or use your data for targeted advertising, so there is nothing for these signals to switch off. We treat a [Global Privacy Control](https://globalprivacycontrol.org) signal as a valid request to opt out of any sale or sharing of personal information.
**Blocking images.** You can configure your browser or device to prevent images from loading.

blocks.p: If we add analytics, advertising, or other tracking technologies in the future, we will update this section and, where the law requires, ask for your consent first.

sections.heading: How we share your personal information

blocks.p: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only as described below, or as otherwise disclosed to you at the time of collection:

list: **Service providers.** Companies that process personal information on our behalf to help run the Site and our business, under terms that limit how they may use it. The providers we currently use for the Site are listed below.
**Professional advisors**, such as lawyers, accountants, and insurers, in the course of the services they provide to us.

**Authorities and others,** when we believe in good faith that disclosure is required by law, subpoena, or legal process, or is necessary to protect our rights, property, or safety or those of others, or to detect and prevent fraud and security issues.
**Business transferees,** in connection with an actual or prospective merger, acquisition, financing, or sale of all or part of our business or assets.
**Third parties you direct us to,** or with your consent.

blocks.p: If you become a client, we may also use invoicing, payment, file-sharing, and project-management tools. Their providers process information under their own privacy policies and our agreements with them.

We keep personal information for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, including answering inquiries, performing client work, and meeting legal, tax, accounting, and reporting requirements, resolving disputes, and enforcing our agreements. To decide how long, we consider the amount, nature, and sensitivity of the information, the risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure, the purposes for which we process it and whether we can achieve them another way, and applicable legal requirements.

When we no longer need personal information, we delete or anonymize it. If that is not possible right away (for example, because it sits in a backup), we securely store it and isolate it from further use until deletion is possible.
Everyone can do the following, wherever they live:

list: **Access, correct, or delete.** Ask us what personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it.

**Opt out of marketing.** Use the unsubscribe instructions in any marketing email, or contact us. You may still receive service-related messages, such as replies to your inquiry or project communications.
**Withdraw consent.** Where we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time. This does not affect processing that happened before you withdrew it.

**Decline to provide information.** You can choose not to give us information, but we may then be unable to respond to your inquiry or provide a service. Our contact form needs your name, email address, service of interest, and message to work.
**Cookies and tracking.** See "Cookies and similar technologies" above.

blocks.p: To exercise any of these choices, write to {email}. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request. Residents of certain states and countries have additional rights, described below.

This section applies to residents of U.S. states whose comprehensive privacy laws apply to us, such as California, Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia, Texas, and Oregon (together, the "State Privacy Laws"). You may submit a request regardless of where you live in the United States, and we will handle it as required by the law that applies to you. Not every right is available in every state, and we may decline a request where the law permits.

list: **Know and access:** the categories of personal information we collected, the sources, our purposes, the categories of third parties we disclosed it to, and a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
**Correct** inaccurate personal information.
**Delete** the personal information we collected from you.
**Portability:** receive your personal information in a portable format where the law provides.
**Opt out** of the sale or sharing of personal information, targeted advertising, and profiling. See below: we do not engage in these activities.
**Limit the use of sensitive personal information.** See below: we do not intentionally collect it.
**Appeal** our decision on a request.
**Non-discrimination:** we will not deny you services, charge different prices, or provide a different quality of service for exercising these rights.

**No sale or sharing.** In the 12 months before the date of this policy, we have not sold personal information or shared it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We have no actual knowledge that we sell or share the personal information of anyone under 16.
**No targeted advertising or profiling.** We do not process personal information for targeted advertising, or for profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects.
**Sensitive personal information.** We do not intentionally collect it and do not use it to infer characteristics about you.
**De-identified data.** We do not attempt to re-identify de-identified information.

blocks.p: Email {email} or call {phone}. Use the subject "Privacy request," and tell us your state of residence and which right you want to exercise. We will confirm receipt within 10 business days and respond within 45 days. If we need more time, we may extend that period once by up to 45 more days and will tell you why.

To protect you, we verify requests by matching the information you give us (for example, the email address and details of your inquiry) against what we hold. We will not ask for government ID unless the law allows it and it is necessary. You may use an authorized agent to submit a request for you. We may ask for your signed written permission and to verify your identity directly.

If we deny your request, you may appeal by replying to our response with the subject "Appeal." We will respond in writing within the period the law requires (generally 45 to 60 days). If you are not satisfied with the result, you may contact your state attorney general.

If you contact us from the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom, or another country with data protection laws, this section adds to the rest of this policy. References to "personal information" include "personal data" as defined in those laws.
{legalName} is the controller of the personal data described in this policy. You can reach us using the details in "Contact us."
Where the EU or UK General Data Protection Regulation applies, we rely on these legal bases:
